pairs: Hi quoque venerunt ad David in Siceleg,
Also, these went to David at Ziklag,
cum adhuc fugeret Saul filium Cis,
while he was still fleeing from Saul, the son of Kish.
qui erant fortissimi et egregii pugnatores,
And they were very strong and distinguished fighters,
et utraque manu fundis saxa jacientes, et dirigentes sagittas,
and using either hand in casting stones with slings, and shooting arrows.
From the brothers of Saul, out of Benjamin:
with Joash, sons of Shemaah from Gibeah,
et Jaziel, et Phallet filii Azmoth,
and Jeziel and Pelet, sons of Azmaveth,
and Beracah and Jehu, from Anathoth.
Samaias quoque Gabaonites fortissimus inter triginta et super triginta. Jeremias, et Jeheziel, et Johanan, et Jezabad Gaderothites.
Also, there was Ishmaiah, from Gibeon, the strongest among the thirty and over the thirty; Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Jozabad, from Gederah;
Joëla quoque, et Zabadia filii Jeroham de Gedor.
and also Joelah and Zebadiah, sons of Jeroham, from Gedor.
Sed et de Gaddi transfugerunt ad David cum lateret in deserto,
Then too, from Gad, there went over to David,
when he was hiding in the desert, very robust men,
taking hold of shield and spear;
their faces were like the faces of a lion,
et veloces quasi capreæ in montibus:
and they were swift like the roe deer upon the mountains.
Hi de filiis Gad principes exercitus:
These were from the sons of Gad, leaders of the army.
novissimus centum militibus præerat, et maximus mille.
The least was in charge of one hundred soldiers, and the greatest was in charge of one thousand.
Isti sunt qui transierunt Jordanem mense primo,
These are the ones who crossed over the Jordan in the first month,
quando inundare consuevit super ripas suas:
when it is accustomed to overflow its banks.
et omnes fugaverunt qui morabantur in vallibus ad orientalem plagam
And they put to flight all those who were staying in the valleys,
to the eastern region and to the west.
Venerunt autem et de Benjamin et de Juda ad præsidium in quo morabatur David.
Then some from Benjamin and from Judah also arrived at the stronghold where David was staying.
And David went out to meet them,
Si pacifice venistis ad me ut auxiliemini mihi,
so as to be a help to me,
si autem insidiamini mihi pro adversariis meis,
may my heart be joined to you;
cum ego iniquitatem in manibus non habeam,
but if to betray me to my adversaries,
though I have no iniquity in my hands,
may the God of our fathers see and judge.”
Spiritus vero induit Amasai principem inter triginta,
Truly, the Spirit clothed Amasai, the leader among the thirty,
and he appointed them as leaders of troops.
Porro de Manasse transfugerunt ad David,
Moreover, some from Manasseh crossed over to David,
quando veniebat cum Philisthiim adversus Saul ut pugnaret:
when he went forth with the Philistines against Saul, so that he might fight.
But he did not fight with them.
quia inito consilio remiserunt eum principes Philisthinorum,
For the leaders of the Philistines, taking counsel, sent him back,
Periculo capitis nostri revertetur ad dominum suum Saul.
“To the peril of our own heads, he will return to his lord, Saul.”
Quando igitur reversus est in Siceleg,
And so, when he returned to Ziklag,
some fled over to him from Manasseh:
Hi præbuerunt auxilium David adversus latrunculos:
These offered assistance to David against the robbers.
For all were very strong men,
et facti sunt principes in exercitu.
and they became leaders in the army.
Sed et per singulos dies veniebant ad David ad auxiliandum ei,
Then, too, some came to David throughout each day,
in order to help him, until they became a great number,
Iste quoque est numerus principum exercitus qui venerunt ad David cum esset in Hebron,
Now this is the number of the leaders of the army who went to David when he was at Hebron,
ut transferrent regnum Saul ad eum,
so that they might transfer the kingdom of Saul to him,
in accord with the word of the Lord:
Filii Juda portantes clypeum et hastam,
the sons of Judah, carrying shield and spear,
sex millia octingenti expediti ad prælium.
six thousand eight hundred, equipped for battle;
De filiis Simeon virorum fortissimorum ad pugnandum,
from the sons of Simeon, very strong men for the fight,
Jojoda quoque princeps de stirpe Aaron,
as well as Jehoiada, a leader from the stock of Aaron,
et cum eo tria millia septingenti.
and with him three thousand seven hundred;
and then Zadok, a youth of distinguished qualities,
and the house of his father,
De filiis autem Benjamin fratribus Saul,
and from the sons of Benjamin, brothers of Saul,
magna enim pars eorum adhuc sequebatur domum Saul.
for still a great part of them were following the house of Saul.
Porro de filiis Ephraim viginti millia octingenti,
Then from the sons of Ephraim, there were twenty thousand eight hundred,
fortissimi robore, viri nominati in cognationibus suis.
very strong and robust men, renowned among their kindred.
And out of the one half tribe of Manasseh,
went forth so that they might appoint David as king.
De filiis quoque Issachar viri eruditi,
Also, from the sons of Issachar, there were learned men,
qui noverant singula tempora ad præcipiendum quid facere deberet Israël,
who knew each of the times, in order to anticipate what Israel ought to do,
omnis autem reliqua tribus eorum consilium sequebatur.
And all the remainder of the tribe were following their counsel.
Porro de Zabulon qui egrediebantur ad prælium,
Then, from Zebulun, there were those who went forth to battle,
et stabant in acie instructi armis bellicis,
and who were standing in a battle line, prepared with the weapons of warfare;
these fifty thousand arrived to assist,
et cum eis instructi clypeo et hasta,
and with them were thirty-seven thousand,
De Dan etiam præparati ad prælium, viginti octo millia sexcenti.
And then from Dan, there were twenty-eight thousand six hundred, ready for battle.
Et de Aser egredientes ad pugnam,
And from Asher, there were forty thousand,
et in acie provocantes, quadraginta millia.
going forth to fight, and summoned to the battle line.
Trans Jordanem autem de filiis Ruben,
Then, across the Jordan, there were,
and from Gad, and from the one half tribe of Manasseh,
instructi armis bellicis, centum viginti millia.
one hundred twenty thousand, prepared with the weapons of warfare.
Omnes isti viri bellatores expediti ad pugnandum,
All these men of war, equipped for the fight,
went with a perfect heart to Hebron,
ut constituerent regem David super universum Israël:
so that they might appoint David as king over all of Israel.
sed et omnes reliqui ex Israël uno corde erant,
Then, too, all the remainder of Israel were of one heart,
so that they might make David king.
Fueruntque ibi apud David tribus diebus comedentes
And they were in that place with David for three days,
For their brothers had made preparations for them.
those who were near to them,
on donkeys and camels and mules and oxen,
